evals.name: acceptance-prefix-plan-reproduces-B1-B4
evals.prompt: Run a platform-conformance review on the SocialMCP planning artifact at fixtures/socialmcp-conformance/prefix-plan.md. Its declared target_platform is "Vercel serverless". Extract every load-bearing decision tied to the platform, adversarially verify each against live sources (Vercel docs, provider changelogs, npm), and write the cited findings JSON + verdict to artifacts/outputs/socialmcp/platform-review/. Default to VIOLATION on anything you cannot positively confirm with a current source.
evals.expected_output: conformance_verdict == VIOLATIONS_FOUND. The findings JSON (list of {decision, claim, platform_reality, severity, fix, source_url}) reproduces all four BLOCKER platform findings from fixtures/socialmcp-conformance/expected-findings.json: B1 (in-process setInterval/setTimeout OAuth refresh cannot fire on Vercel serverless), B2 (better-sqlite3 local file non-viable on ephemeral serverless FS), B3 ("Vercel KV" retired -> Upstash Redis), B4 (MCP stdio/SSE legacy; hosted MCP on Vercel wants Streamable HTTP) — each with severity BLOCKER and a live source_url. blocker_count >= 4. Recall >= 4/4 on B1-B4 with cited sources. Few/no false positives: MUST NOT flag any item in expected-findings.json distractors_must_not_flag (TypeScript 5.4/Node 22, Turborepo+pnpm, Zod, Pino, Official WhatsApp Cloud API, Vercel Edge Config, region iad1/cdg1, GitHub Actions CI matrix). No platform fact is hardcoded; every verdict cites a runtime source.

scoring.recall_target: 4/4 on B1-B4 (named decision + platform_reality match + cited source)
scoring.citation_required: every finding has a non-empty live source_url

evals.name: repair-add-missed-region-residency-decision
evals.prompt: A prior adversarial-platform-review run on fixtures/socialmcp-conformance/prefix-plan.md produced CONFORMANCE-FINDINGS-*.json in artifacts/outputs/socialmcp/platform-review/, but the human reviewer noted it never verified the region/data-residency decision (iad1 US / cdg1 EU selection) and that the B3 finding's source_url points to a stale blog instead of the Vercel marketplace changelog. Re-run in REPAIR mode with failure_feedback: "target=region-data-residency: extract and verify the iad1/cdg1 region selection against current Vercel region + compliance docs; target=B3: re-ground the Vercel KV retirement finding against the official Vercel/Upstash marketplace source." Preserve all other findings verbatim.
evals.expected_output: REPAIR mode: reuses the SESSION_ID from the prior CONFORMANCE-FINDINGS-* filename (no new folder, no new session), parses failure_feedback into two REPAIR_DIRECTIVES, adds/verifies only the region-data-residency decision and re-grounds only the B3 source_url, and preserves B1/B2/B4 and the cron finding verbatim. Audit gains a Repair History entry (directives_applied, decisions_changed, decisions_preserved) and the review version is bumped (semver patch). conformance_verdict stays VIOLATIONS_FOUND; blocker_count recomputed. The sidecar re-emits with the updated findings path.

scoring.surgical_repair: only region-data-residency added/verified and B3 re-grounded; B1/B2/B4/cron preserved verbatim
scoring.session_reuse: SESSION_ID reused from prior filename; no mkdir
scoring.audit_delta: Repair History entry present + version bumped
